Streetlights blink awake one by one
I count the stops until the road turns familiar
Every mile a little closer to done

[Chorus]
The fields blur past in gentle shapes tonight
Carry Me Home
The radio hums a tune I half recall
Carry Me Home

[Verse 2]
The radio hums an old forgotten tune
Window cracked to let the night air in
I watch the fields blur into gentle shapes
And feel the weight of the day begin to thin

[Chorus]
Carry Me Home
Through every turn I know so well
Carry Me Home
Where the porch steps still remember my name

[Bridge]
Every road I've taken led me back again
Every light still burning just the same

[Chorus]
Carry Me Home
Through every turn I know so well
Carry Me Home
Where the porch steps still remember my name
